title: Discounts and coupons
intro: Configure promotional pricing: discount rules with reasons and role permissions, plus coupon codes staff can apply at payment.

sections.title: Discount rules
sections.intro: Discount rules define automatic or manual reductions by category, scope, and eligibility.
steps: Open the Discounts tab in Manage.
Select the Rules sub-tab.
Add or edit rules; set type, value, scope, and when the discount applies.
sections.caption: Discount rules list.

sections.title: Discount reasons
sections.intro: Reasons appear when staff apply manual discounts so reporting can track why a reduction was given.
steps: Open Discounts and switch to the Reasons sub-tab.
Create reasons staff can pick at the payment or cart screen.
Deactivate reasons you no longer want offered.
sections.caption: Discount reasons maintenance.

sections.title: Discount permissions
sections.intro: Control which roles may apply each discount type or exceed limits without manager approval.
steps: Open Discounts and switch to the Permissions sub-tab.
Review the matrix of roles versus discount capabilities.
Adjust permissions so only authorized roles can grant large or sensitive discounts.
sections.caption: Discount permission matrix.

sections.title: Coupons
steps: Open the Coupons tab.
Create coupon codes with value, validity window, and usage limits.
Staff enter coupons on the payment screen when the order qualifies.
sections.caption: Coupons tab.

sections.title: Formulario de regla de descuento
sections.intro: Categorías: manager, staff, vip, corporate, happy_hour, category, product, floor, damage_wastage, service_recovery, bulk_order, manual, scheduled, buy_x_get_y. Alcance: item, category, cart, customer, floor.
steps: Admin → Promociones → Descuentos → Reglas.
Defina categoría, alcance y modo (manual, automático o ambos).
Configure objetivos según alcance.
Defina valor, apilamiento, impuestos y horarios.
Guarde — caché se actualiza y regla disponible en POS.
sections.caption: Formulario con categoría y objetivos.

sections.title: Formulario de cupón
steps: Abra Promociones → Cupones.
Defina código, tipo/valor de descuento y límites de uso.
Configure días, ventana horaria y rango de fechas.
Guarde — cajeros ingresan el código al pagar.
